sources.entry: uPaste - Clipboard history and snippets manager for organizing reusable copied content. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1503649026?pt=119209922&ct=github)

summary.name: uPaste
summary.one_liner: uPaste is a macOS clipboard manager that automatically records and organizes copy/paste history, with tagging, search and snippet lists.
use_cases: Recovering previously copied text, images or files
Organizing reusable snippets for repeated use
Searching clipboard history by keyword or app name
Tagging important copied items into custom lists
summary.what_it_does: uPaste records copy history automatically and keeps copied text, images and files organized in sidebars. Items can be previewed and reused by clicking or with keyboard shortcuts. A search function, triggered with cmd + J, finds clipboard items by keyword or app name. Users can tag history items into their own lists and drag and drop to reorder them, and starred lists group snippets automatically.
notable: Search clipboard with cmd + J, similar to Spotlight
Tagging and auto-grouping into starred lists
Drag and drop reordering of history items
caveats: Requires OS X 10.15 or later, per the page
Pricing is not stated on the page; the description calls it free but does not detail paid tiers
Version 1.4.5, 25.2 MB app size listed; page may be out of date
